findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buy_library_model, get_library_purchase, get_training_job, send_job_feedback, get_commercial_license · Private data: create_training_job, get_training_job, create_commercial_license · Public sink: estimate_wake_word, send_job_feedback, settle_x402_payment · Destructive: estimate_wake_word, search_wake_word_library, test_wake_word_live, get_library_purchase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buy_library_model, get_library_purchase, get_training_job, send_job_feedback, get_commercial_license · Private data: create_training_job, get_training_job, create_commercial_license · Public sink: estimate_wake_word, send_job_feedback, settle_x402_payment · Destructive: estimate_wake_word, search_wake_word_library, test_wake_word_live, get_library_purchase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
